newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Great Ocean 1996 net drops 29.75 pct.
newsitem.headline: Great Ocean 1996 net drops 29.75 pct.

text.p: (in millions of yuan unless stated, against 1995 figures)
Net assets per share 1.64 yuan vs 1.77 yuan
Earnings per share 0.186 yuan vs 0.34 yuan
Full company name is Shenzhen Great Ocean Shipping Co Ltd.

NOTE: The results were published in a company annual report in the Shenzhen-based Securities Times. The net profit figures were based on international accounting standards and other figures on domestic Chinese accounting standards.
Net profits should be 33.57 million yuan for 1996 against 50.39 million yuan based on domestic accounting standards.
Earnings per share is calculated on a fully-diluted basis.

The company's board of directors proposes a 0.08 yuan per share cash dividend for all shareholders from its 1996 profits pending approval by shareholders at a meeting scheduled for April 30, a company statement said.
